description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'ModelTraitNormalizeNestedCollectionTest' that tests the normalization of nested collections using the ModelTrait in the OrangeHRM project. It also includes a mock class 'TestEmployee' and 'EmployeeModel' implementing the 'Normalizable' interface, designed to verify the behavior of nested collection normalization logic.

classes.name: ModelTraitNormalizeNestedCollectionTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing nested collection normalization functionality.

classes.name: TestEmployee
classes.description: A mock class representing an employee with id, name, and supervisors, used for testing nested collection normalization.

classes.name: EmployeeModel
classes.description: A mock model class implementing 'Normalizable' to test the 'ModelTrait'.

methods.name: testCallNestedCollections
methods.description: Tests normalization of a nested collection with a single level of supervision.

methods.name: testCallNestedCollectionsFor
methods.description: Tests normalization of nested collections with multiple fields and nested relationships.
